segments.text: Hamagi salam, man ismim Komale, yashi migirma sakkizda.
Va man, magisla tori talabas bolish uchun kura shishke qararkaldim.
Bugun hayalarni yok qalib, ingilis tala darajamni yakhshilashke qararkaldim.
Is it possible to learn English online on your own?
It's possible for you to learn how to speak English online by yourself.
But you need to practice also with people around you.
Or especially native speakers or people around you that know how to speak in English very well.
